resources.string: Floating windows
More floating windows
Raise the window replacement threshold to 256. Other device limits may still apply.
Force allow floating windows
Relax app compatibility checks for floating windows. Some apps may display incorrectly.
Keep pinned windows in the foreground
Apply the foreground policy the next time a window is pinned. This may increase power use.
Manage floating-window behavior and choose when other apps open in one
Window behavior
Launch scenarios
Open other apps in floating windows
Apply only to the scenarios enabled below. The system still checks whether the target supports floating windows.
Tap notifications
Tap a notification while unlocked to open its app in a floating window when supported.
Taplus and Copy to open links
Use a floating window when you open a recognized web link from Taplus or Copy to open.
Share to other apps
Open the receiving app in a floating window when sharing. Includes the WeChat callback.
Copy Direct tokens
Open the receiving app in a floating window when you tap a recognized token.
Copy Direct places
Open the map app in a floating window when you tap a recognized address.
Copy Direct parcel tracking
Open the tracking app in a floating window when you tap a recognized tracking number.
